models.name: FOCUS SPIN
notes: Do not uninstall SPIN 3.3 if an existing substance database must be retained.

models.name: FOCUS PEARL
notes: Latest released PEARL is preferred for new regulatory submissions.
SPIN must be installed locally first.
With SPIN 4.4, edit TSCF in standalone SPIN if the PEARL-hosted field is disabled; do not use 0.5 without a relevant substance-specific basis.

models.name: FOCUS SWASH
notes: SWASH is the Step 3 orchestration shell, not the fate solver.
It prepares MACRO/PRZM/TOXSWA projects and the drift inputs.
After opening/editing Applications, save and export the project before running TOXSWA to avoid the documented 100% drift problem.

models.name: FOCUS MACRO
notes: The 5.5.4a package adds the .NET Framework 4.7.2 prerequisite for Windows 11; the installed model remains essentially the 5.5.4/MACRO 5.2 implementation.
MACRO supplies the Chateaudun groundwater scenario and drainage inputs for six FOCUS surface-water scenarios.
Retain .m2t files and the upstream SWASH project when MACRO drainage is passed to TOXSWA.
Check the documented lower-case filename requirement if the standalone M2T tool is used.

models.name: FOCUS TOXSWA
notes: Install SWASH first and keep TOXSWA beneath the same SWASH drive/directory structure.
TOXSWA receives drift plus MACRO drainage or PRZM runoff/erosion loadings.
The SPIN 4.4 close-time Runtime error 216 is documented as not affecting runs.

scientific_boundary: FOCUS tools are pesticide exposure models. Use for pharmaceuticals, biosolids or wastewater irrigation is an adapted research/comparative workflow unless a receiving authority explicitly accepts it.
